pick.name: Gemini API free tier (Google AI Studio)
pick.what: Free-of-charge Gemini Flash/Flash-Lite/2.5 Pro, Gemma 4 and Gemini Embedding 2 via API key
pick.why: Widest free model set incl. multimodal and embeddings; good for prototyping and eval-judge runs
pick.free_limits: Free input/output on Gemini 3.8/3.6 Flash, 3.5 Flash-Lite, 3 Flash Preview, 2.5 Pro/Flash/Flash-Lite, Gemini Embedding 2, Gemma 4 and Flash TTS models; NOT Gemini 4 Argon, 3.1 Pro or Nano Banana image models. Free-tier prompts/outputs used to improve Google products and may be human-reviewed; terms say do not submit sensitive, confidential or personal info. RPM/RPD shown only in AI Studio (docs updated 2026-10-26); RPD resets midnight Pacific. Search grounding: Gemini 3+ rows say free tier not available (tools section mentions 500 RPD shared Flash/Flash-Lite); 5,000/mo is the paid tier. Apps offered to EEA users must use Paid Services only.
pick.commercial_ok: yes (free tier trains on data; use paid tier for client/PHI data)

alts.name: Groq (free plan)
alts.what: Very fast inference of gpt-oss-120b/20b, Qwen3.8-27b, Whisper, Prompt Guard 2
alts.why: Best free latency; also free Whisper + safety classifiers
alts.free_limits: Table on page (unclear whether Free or Developer column): gpt-oss-120b 30 RPM / 1K RPD / 8K TPM / 200K TPD; whisper-large-v3-turbo 20 RPM / 2K RPD; Prompt Guard 2 30 RPM / 14.4K RPD

alts.name: OpenRouter free (:free) models
alts.what: One OpenAI-compatible key for 25+ free models from 4 providers
alts.why: Single key, easy to swap; $10 top-up lifts daily cap
alts.free_limits: 20 req/min; 50 req/day (<10 credits bought) or 1,000/day (>=10 credits bought); negative balance blocks free models

candidates.name: Gemini API free tier
candidates.verdict: Pick: broadest free models, multimodal, embeddings; trains on data

candidates.name: Groq free
candidates.verdict: Alt: fastest, small daily caps, free Whisper

candidates.name: OpenRouter :free
candidates.verdict: Alt: many models one key; 50/day unless $10 bought

candidates.name: Cerebras free trial
candidates.verdict: Only $5 credits expiring in 30 days, 5 RPM - a trial, not a free tier

candidates.name: Mistral Experiment
candidates.verdict: Docs URL 404 in my fetch; limits unverified

decision: Gemini free tier is the default sandbox for non-sensitive prototyping; use Groq when latency/Whisper matters and OpenRouter to try many open models. Never send customer or PHI data to any free tier (Gemini free explicitly trains on it).

verify.note: Free model list mostly confirmed (Gemini 4 Argon now exists, not free). Errors: 5,000/mo Search grounding is the PAID-tier allowance; '3.1 Flash-Lite' is not a listed free text model (3.5 Flash-Lite is). Terms add rules the pick omits: do not submit sensitive/personal info to Unpaid Services, and apps made available to EEA users must use Paid Services only (matters for global sales).
